grants.title: ERC Starting Grant
grants.description: Supports talented early-career researchers to build their own team and start independent research in any field ("bottom-up", no set priorities).
grants.amount: Up to €1.5M (+ up to €1M extra for start-up/equipment/relocation)
grants.eligibility: 2–7 yrs post-PhD (widens to 0–10 yrs from 2027 calls); any nationality; host in EU/Associated Country
grants.notes: Eligibility window from certified PhD defence date; extensions for parental leave, illness, etc.

grants.title: ERC Consolidator Grant
grants.description: Helps researchers consolidate independence by establishing/strengthening a team and their own research programme.
grants.eligibility: 7–12 yrs post-PhD (widens to 5–15 yrs from 2027 calls); any nationality; host in EU/Associated Country
grants.notes: 349 grants / €728M awarded in the 2025 round.

grants.title: ERC Advanced Grant
grants.description: For established, world-class research leaders with a recognised track record, to pursue ambitious high-risk/high-gain projects.
grants.amount: Up to €2.5M (+ up to €1M extra if in EU/Assoc. country; up to €2M if relocating from a non-associated third country)
grants.eligibility: No fixed window; must show exceptional ~10-yr track record; host in EU/Associated Country
grants.notes: Closing 17:00 Brussels time. Advanced 2026 applicants cannot apply to Synergy 2027. Extra funding now also covers personnel costs (new 2026). Verified 14 Jul 2026.

grants.title: ERC Synergy Grant
grants.description: Funds groups of 2–4 PIs to jointly tackle ambitious problems no individual could address alone.
grants.eligibility: 2–4 PIs; at least one meets ERC PI criteria; all PIs must remain eligible throughout
grants.deadline_text: Late autumn 2026 (typical; confirm in Work Programme)
grants.interview: Yes — Step 2 interview for shortlisted PI groups
grants.notes: From 2027, if one PI is ineligible the whole proposal is rejected.

grants.title: ERC Proof of Concept Grant
grants.description: Lump-sum funding to explore commercial/societal innovation potential of results from an existing ERC project.
grants.eligibility: Must hold (or have held) an ERC frontier-research grant the idea derives from
grants.notes: Only open to existing ERC grantees.

grants.title: ERC Plus Grant
grants.description: New scheme (launched 2026) for projects beyond regular ERC scale, where a standard ERC grant would be too small.
grants.amount: Larger than standard ERC grants (see call)
grants.eligibility: Similar to Advanced Grant profile; see 2026 Work Programme
grants.interview: Not specified for first edition — check call
grants.notes: First edition launched in ERC 2026 Work Programme.

grants.title: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships
grants.description: Fellowships for postdocs to work abroad, gain new skills and develop careers; European and Global streams.
grants.amount: Salary + mobility, research & family allowances (100% covered)
grants.eligibility: PhD holder, max 8 yrs full-time research post-PhD; mobility rule (no >12 months in host country in prior 36)
grants.application_mode: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (with host org)
grants.notes: Call HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01; €399.05M, ~1,600 projects. ~40 ERA Fellowships for widening countries. Applicants scoring <80% in the 2025 call cannot reapply with the same host org. Verified 14 Jul 2026.

grants.title: MSCA Doctoral Networks
grants.description: Consortia run joint doctoral training programmes across academia and industry; includes Industrial and Joint Doctorates.
grants.amount: Unit-cost based (living, mobility, family, training + overheads)
grants.duration: Project up to 4 yrs (JD up to 5)
grants.eligibility: ≥3 legal entities in ≥3 different countries (≥1 in an EU Member State); recruits are early-stage researchers
grants.notes: 2026 budget €593M, >130 projects, ~1,950 PhD candidates. New RAISE AI-in-Science pilot (€30M).

grants.title: MSCA COFUND
grants.description: Co-funds new or existing doctoral / postdoctoral programmes run by eligible organisations.
grants.eligibility: Organisations in EU Member States / Horizon Europe Associated Countries
grants.notes: 2026 budget €105.46M. "Choose Europe for Science" strand added in 2026/27.

grants.title: MSCA Staff Exchanges
grants.description: Short-term international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary staff secondments to transfer knowledge.
grants.eligibility: Consortium from ≥3 countries; academic and non-academic organisations

grants.title: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.description: Supports excellent postdocs in the life sciences worldwide; international mobility is a core requirement.
grants.amount: Salary/stipend + relocation + child support (rate depends on country)
grants.eligibility: Within ~2 yrs of PhD; international mobility required; project must not directly continue PhD work
grants.interview: Yes — ~90-min online interview with presentation (top ~25% shortlisted)
grants.notes: First-author refereed preprint counts as a publication. From Autumn 2027: one proposal only, no re-applications.

grants.title: EMBO Installation Grants
grants.region: Select EMBC member states (e.g. CZ, EE, GR, LT, LU, PL, PT, TR)
grants.description: Helps researchers set up their own labs in participating (mostly widening) member states; includes networking and support.
grants.eligibility: Establishing first independent lab in a participating country; typically 2–9 yrs post-PhD
grants.notes: Available only in specific participating countries that fund the scheme.

grants.title: HFSP Postdoctoral Fellowships (LTF & CDF)
grants.description: Long-Term (LTF) and Cross-Disciplinary (CDF) fellowships for postdocs pursuing frontier life-science research abroad.
grants.eligibility: PhD conferred ≤3 yrs before Full Proposal deadline; must work outside country of nationality
grants.interview: No — written LOI + Full Proposal review
grants.notes: Fellowship activates 1 Apr 2027 – 1 Jan 2028. Each host supervisor may endorse only one LOI/year.

grants.title: HFSP Research Grants (Program / Early Career)
grants.description: Funds international, interdisciplinary teams for innovative basic research into complex living systems.
grants.amount: Team grant (amount depends on team size)
grants.eligibility: International team; postdocs not eligible as applicants; PI-level scientists only
grants.deadline_text: LOI 26 Mar 2026; Full Proposal mid-Sep 2026 (awards Mar 2027)
grants.interview: No — written LOI + Full Proposal review
grants.notes: Two streams: RG-Program and RG-Early Career. No applicant on >1 LOI per cycle.

grants.title: Branco Weiss Fellowship – Society in Science
grants.description: Generous personal fellowship letting early-career postdocs pursue unconventional, interdisciplinary research anywhere in the world.
grants.eligibility: Held (or near) a PhD; typically ≤5 yrs post-PhD at application; any discipline with a novel, interdisciplinary angle
grants.notes: One of the most flexible early-career awards; portable to almost any institution.

grants.title: Schmidt Science Fellows
grants.funding_body: Schmidt Science Fellows (in partnership with Rhodes Trust)
grants.description: Supports newly graduated PhDs to pivot into a new discipline via a postdoc in a different field, with leadership training.
grants.eligibility: Completing/completed a PhD in natural sciences, engineering, maths or computing; nominated by a partner university
grants.notes: Requires nomination by a partner institution; emphasis on interdisciplinary "pivot".

grants.title: DFG Research Grants (Sachbeihilfe)
grants.description: Germany's core individual grant for a specific, time-limited research project; can include the applicant's own position ("eigene Stelle").
grants.amount: Project costs incl. staff, equipment, consumables (no fixed cap)
grants.eligibility: Completed academic training (usually a doctorate); research at a German institution
grants.notes: Open to researchers worldwide working in Germany.

grants.title: DFG Walter Benjamin Programme
grants.description: Funds researchers in the immediate postdoc phase to independently carry out their own project at a host of their choice.
grants.eligibility: Recently completed doctorate; mobility conditions apply; host institution support required
grants.notes: Cannot run in parallel with another DFG project.

grants.title: DFG Emmy Noether Programme
grants.description: Lets outstanding early-career researchers qualify for a professorship by leading an independent junior research group.
grants.amount: Group leader salary + staff + project + family allowances
grants.eligibility: Normally ≤4 yrs post-PhD with ≥2 yrs postdoc experience; substantial international experience; all disciplines
grants.notes: Applicants from abroad expected to continue in Germany after funding.

grants.title: DFG Heisenberg Programme
grants.description: Supports researchers already qualified for a professorship to continue high-level research while preparing for a leadership role.
grants.eligibility: Must meet all requirements for appointment to a permanent professorship
grants.notes: Several modules (position, professorship, etc.).

grants.title: Humboldt Research Fellowship
grants.description: Enables researchers from abroad to conduct long-term research in Germany with a host of their choice.
grants.eligibility: Researchers based abroad; postdoc (within ~4 yrs of PhD) or experienced (within ~12 yrs); any nationality/discipline
grants.notes: Highly flexible; strong alumni network.

grants.title: Volkswagen Foundation – Freigeist / Momentum etc.
grants.description: Independent private funder offering changing initiatives for bold, high-risk and interdisciplinary research (e.g. "Momentum", topical calls).
grants.eligibility: Depends on the specific initiative; often researchers at German institutions
grants.notes: Programme portfolio changes over time; the "Freigeist" scheme has been discontinued/replaced — check current calls.

grants.title: UKRI Future Leaders Fellowships
grants.description: Flexible, long-term fellowships to help researchers and innovators become leaders, across academia and business.
grants.amount: No fixed cap (often ~£0.3M–£2M+); UKRI funds 80% of full economic cost
grants.eligibility: Based at an eligible UK research organisation; no fixed years-since-PhD limit; must justify early-career status
grants.notes: Institutions cap the number of applications; internal selection usual.

grants.title: UKRI Council Responsive-Mode Grants
grants.description: Investigator-led project grants across the seven UKRI research councils; each council runs its own schemes.
grants.eligibility: PI at an eligible UK research organisation; council-specific rules
grants.notes: Pick the council matching your discipline (e.g. EPSRC for engineering/physics, MRC for biomedical).

grants.title: Wellcome Early-Career Awards
grants.description: Supports early-career researchers in any discipline (linked to human health) to develop their research identity and independence.
grants.eligibility: Some postdoc experience but not yet independent; hosted in UK, Ireland, or eligible LMICs; any nationality
grants.notes: From 29 Oct 2026, eligibility narrows to UK + specific LMIC regions.

grants.title: Wellcome Career Development Awards
grants.description: For mid-career researchers ready to lead a substantial, innovative research programme and reach international standing.
grants.eligibility: Already driving own research; hosted in UK, Ireland or eligible LMICs
grants.notes: Cannot be sole applicant on another Wellcome award concurrently.

grants.title: Royal Society University Research Fellowship (URF)
grants.description: Prestigious fellowship for outstanding early-career scientists to build an independent research career in the UK.
grants.eligibility: Typically 3–8 yrs post-PhD; natural sciences (incl. many STEM fields); based at a UK institution
grants.notes: Does not cover clinical medicine or social sciences.

grants.title: Leverhulme Trust – Research Project Grants / Fellowships
grants.description: Funds original, curiosity-driven research across disciplines, valuing cross-disciplinary and unconventional work.
grants.eligibility: Based at a UK institution; scheme-specific eligibility (e.g. Early Career Fellowships for recent PhDs)
grants.notes: Early Career Fellowships are co-funded 50% by the host institution.

grants.title: NWO Talent Programme – Veni
grants.description: Personal grant for recently graduated researchers to develop their own line of research and independence.
grants.eligibility: PhD obtained ≤3 yrs before the round deadline; embedding guarantee from host institution required
grants.notes: Two-stage: narrative CV pre-application, then full proposal.

grants.title: NWO Talent Programme – Vidi
grants.description: For experienced researchers transitioning to leadership, to set up their own research line and group.
grants.eligibility: PhD obtained ≤8 yrs before the round deadline; academic qualities clearly above peer group
grants.notes: Deadlines shift each annual cycle — check current round.

grants.title: NWO Talent Programme – Vici
grants.description: For senior researchers consolidating and expanding their own research group and line.
grants.eligibility: PhD obtained ≤15 yrs before the round benchmark date; established leadership & mentoring
grants.notes: Highest tier of the NWO Talent Programme.

grants.title: SNSF Project Funding
grants.description: SNSF's main scheme for investigator-driven projects on self-chosen topics.
grants.amount: Avg. max CHF 250,000/yr per applicant; up to CHF 3M/project
grants.eligibility: Independent researcher at a Swiss institution; from 2026 max 2 concurrent grants; 1 proposal/12 months
grants.notes: Rules tightened in 2026 due to budget constraints.

grants.title: SNSF Ambizione
grants.description: Lets early-career researchers run an independent project at a Swiss institution and become scientifically independent.
grants.amount: Salary + project funds (project part max CHF 250k / 4 yrs)
grants.eligibility: ≤4 yrs post-PhD; ≥12 months research post-PhD; Swiss-link required (nationality, degree, or 12 months in CH)
grants.deadline_text: Final call opens 3 Aug 2026; deadline 3 Nov 2026
grants.notes: Being phased out — replaced by a new postdoc scheme from 2028. This is the final call.

grants.title: SNSF Starting Grants
grants.description: SNSF's highest career-funding tier; lead your own independent project and team in Switzerland (alternative to ERC StG).
grants.amount: Up to CHF 1M project funding + salary
grants.eligibility: Doctorate + several yrs research; within eligibility window (~2–8 yrs post-PhD); Swiss-link required
grants.notes: For researchers ineligible/not applying for ERC in Switzerland. Fewer awards 2026–28 due to budget cuts.

grants.title: ANR – Generic Call (AAPG)
grants.description: France's main annual open call funding project-based research (individual and collaborative) across all fields.
grants.eligibility: Researcher at a French research institution; specific instruments (JCJC for young researchers, PRC, PRCE, etc.)
grants.notes: JCJC ("Jeunes Chercheuses et Jeunes Chercheurs") instrument targets early-career researchers.

grants.title: Research Council of Norway – FRIPRO (Early Career)
grants.description: Curiosity-driven grants for early-career researchers at Norwegian institutions to lead their own project.
grants.eligibility: 2–7 yrs post-PhD; affiliated with a Norwegian research institution
grants.notes: FRIPRO also has streams for established researchers and mobility.

grants.title: Swedish Research Council – Project Grant
grants.description: Core project grant supporting researcher-initiated projects of high scientific quality.
grants.eligibility: Doctorate; project at a Swedish administering organisation; discipline-specific calls
grants.notes: Separate calls for natural/engineering, medicine, humanities/social sciences, educational sciences.

grants.title: Research Council of Finland – Academy Project / Fellowship
grants.description: Academy Projects fund high-quality research; Academy Research Fellowships support researchers building independence.
grants.eligibility: Doctorate; project at a Finnish research institution; fellowship for researchers pursuing independence
grants.notes: Formerly the "Academy of Finland".

grants.title: Novo Nordisk Foundation – research grants
grants.description: One of the world's largest private funders; many programmes (e.g. Emerging Investigator, Challenge, Laureate) mainly in the Nordic region.
grants.amount: Programme-dependent (e.g. up to DKK 12.5M over 5 yrs for some)
grants.eligibility: Depends on programme; often researchers in Denmark / Nordic countries; some now open to Europe
grants.interview: Sometimes — e.g. Laureate has an on-site interview
grants.notes: Very broad portfolio; verify the specific programme's scope and geography.

grants.title: FWO – Fundamental Research (Flanders)
grants.description: Supports fundamental research in Flanders via PhD/postdoctoral fellowships and research project grants.
grants.duration: Fellowships up to ~3 yrs; projects up to 4 yrs
grants.eligibility: Link to a Flemish university/institution; scheme-specific career stage rules
grants.interview: Sometimes — fellowship interviews for some schemes
grants.notes: Wallonia-Brussels has a separate funder, F.R.S.-FNRS.

grants.title: National Science Centre Poland (NCN) – OPUS / SONATA / PRELUDIUM
grants.description: Poland's main basic-research funder, with tiered schemes by career stage (OPUS broad, SONATA early-career, PRELUDIUM for PhD students).
grants.eligibility: Researcher at a Polish institution; career stage varies by scheme
grants.interview: No — written peer review (some panel discussion)
grants.notes: MAESTRO (experienced) and POLONEZ BIS (incoming, MSCA-cofunded) also available.

grants.title: FCT – Individual Call to Scientific Employment / Projects
grants.funding_body: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
grants.description: Portugal's national funder; funds research projects and researcher contracts (Scientific Employment Stimulus).
grants.duration: Contracts up to 6 yrs; projects up to 3 yrs
grants.eligibility: Doctorate; hosted at a Portuguese R&D institution
grants.notes: Scientific Employment Stimulus provides multi-year researcher contracts.

grants.title: FWF Principal Investigator Projects (Einzelprojekte)
grants.description: Flexible stand-alone project grants for high-quality independent basic research in any discipline; well suited to incoming researchers.
grants.amount: Project costs incl. personnel & materials (~€400k+ typical)
grants.eligibility: Doctorate + appropriate qualifications; project at an Austrian research institution
grants.notes: No fixed deadline. Largest FWF programme by volume.

grants.title: FWF ESPRIT Programme
grants.description: Early-career programme funding a postdoc's own salary and project for 3 years, with a mentor; open to all disciplines.
grants.eligibility: Highly qualified early-career postdocs; project at an Austrian institution; mentor required
grants.notes: Aims to award ≥50% to women. One person can be PI in only one ESPRIT project.

grants.title: FWF ASTRA Awards
grants.description: Consolidation-stage awards for internationally visible researchers to establish themselves as academic leaders in Austria; includes tenure incentives.
grants.amount: €500,000–€1,000,000 (+€200k tenure package for women); Merit Award €450k
grants.eligibility: Doctorate awarded 2–9 yrs before 30 Sep of submission year; evidence of independent research; any discipline
grants.interview: Yes — hearing before an international jury
grants.notes: ~18 awards/yr planned + up to 10 Merit Awards. Half reserved for women. Replaces Elise Richter & START.

grants.title: NIH Research Project Grant (R01)
grants.description: NIH's flagship mature investigator-initiated grant for a discrete, specified health-related research project.
grants.amount: No fixed cap; >$500k/yr direct costs no longer needs prior approval
grants.eligibility: Independent researcher at an eligible (usually US) institution; PD/PI able to lead the project
grants.deadline_text: Standard new dates: 5 Feb, 5 Jun, 5 Oct
grants.notes: Deadlines shift to next business day if on a weekend/holiday. Renewal/resubmission dates differ.

grants.title: NIH Exploratory/Developmental Grant (R21)
grants.description: Supports early-stage, exploratory or developmental research, including high-risk/high-reward pilot work.
grants.amount: Up to $275,000 direct costs over 2 years
grants.eligibility: Independent researcher at an eligible institution; project fits exploratory scope
grants.deadline_text: Standard new dates: 16 Feb, 16 Jun, 16 Oct
grants.notes: Preliminary data not required. Some FOAs override standard dates.

grants.title: NSF Standard/Continuing Grants
grants.description: Core funding for fundamental research and education across science and engineering; each program sets its own terms.
grants.eligibility: PI at an eligible US organisation; see each program solicitation
grants.notes: Distinguishes "target dates" (still accepted after) from "deadline dates" (firm).

grants.title: DAAD Research Grants (Doctoral/Short-Term)
grants.description: Funds international researchers to carry out doctoral or research stays at German institutions.
grants.eligibility: Non-German researchers; requirements vary by scheme and home country
grants.notes: Many sub-schemes; deadlines depend on applicant's home country.

grants.title: DAAD PRIME Postdoctoral Fellowships
grants.description: 18-month positions: 12 months abroad + 6 months at a German university, employment contract instead of stipend.
grants.eligibility: PhD holders of any nationality; German university acts as employer
grants.notes: Combines outgoing and reintegration phases.

grants.title: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds PhD Fellowships
grants.description: Funds outstanding PhD students conducting ambitious basic biomedical research projects worldwide.
grants.eligibility: Applicants must be ≤ a few months into the PhD project; basic biomedical topic
grants.notes: Also offers travel grants (rolling).

grants.title: HHMI Investigator Program
grants.description: 'People, not projects' funding: HHMI employs outstanding scientists, giving long-term flexible support.
grants.amount: ~$9M over 7 years (renewable), incl. salary & research budget
grants.eligibility: Tenured/tenure-track PI at eligible US institution; competition opens periodically
grants.notes: Competitions announced every ~1–2 years.

grants.title: Simons Foundation Grants (Math & Physical Sciences / Life Sciences)
grants.description: Portfolio of grants including Simons Investigators, collaborations, fellowships and targeted programs.
grants.eligibility: Varies; some by nomination only
grants.notes: Investigator awards are nomination-based.

grants.title: L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science
grants.description: International awards plus national/regional Young Talents programs supporting women scientists.
grants.eligibility: Women researchers; criteria vary by national program (Austria has its own)
grants.notes: Check the Austrian/regional Young Talents program for local deadlines.

grants.title: Fulbright Foreign Student & Visiting Scholar Programs
grants.description: Flagship US international exchange: research stays and degrees in the US for non-US researchers.
grants.eligibility: Apply via the Fulbright commission in your home country; criteria vary
grants.notes: Austrian applicants: fulbright.at runs its own annual cycles.

grants.title: EIC Pathfinder (Open & Challenges)
grants.description: Funds visionary, high-risk science-towards-technology research that could create new markets.
grants.eligibility: Consortia (Open: ≥3 entities/3 countries); single entities possible in Challenges
grants.notes: Followed by Transition & Accelerator for later stages.

grants.title: EMBO Scientific Exchange Grants
grants.description: Funds short research visits (up to 3 months) to labs in another country to learn techniques or start collaborations.
grants.eligibility: Life scientists; exchange between eligible countries; not for conferences
grants.notes: Fast decision (~2–4 weeks); great entry-level scheme.

grants.title: Ramón y Cajal Fellowships
grants.description: Spain's flagship tenure-track scheme: 5-year contracts for researchers at Spanish institutions.
grants.eligibility: PhD + postdoc experience (window defined per call); any nationality
grants.notes: Juan de la Cierva scheme covers earlier-stage postdocs.

grants.title: Royal Society Newton International Fellowships
grants.description: Brings outstanding non-UK early-career researchers to UK institutions for 2–3 years.
grants.eligibility: Non-UK based researchers, typically ≤7 yrs post-PhD; UK host required
grants.notes: Includes follow-on alumni funding.

grants.title: Wellcome Discovery Awards
grants.description: Major awards for established researchers and teams pursuing bold, significant research programmes.
grants.eligibility: Established researchers driving a significant programme; eligible host organisation
grants.notes: Same eligibility-narrowing from Oct 2026 as other Wellcome schemes — check site.

grants.title: NSERC Discovery Grants
grants.funding_body: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC)
grants.description: Canada's core long-term programme funding ongoing research programs rather than single projects.
grants.eligibility: Faculty at eligible Canadian universities
grants.deadline_text: Annual: NOI ~1 Aug, full application ~1 Nov
grants.notes: Notification of Intent is mandatory before full application.

grants.title: CIHR Project Grants
grants.description: Canada's main investigator-initiated health research competition.
grants.eligibility: Independent researcher at eligible Canadian institution
grants.notes: Registration deadline precedes full application.

grants.title: ARC Discovery Projects
grants.description: Australia's main scheme for fundamental investigator-initiated research.
grants.eligibility: PI at eligible Australian institution
grants.notes: Medical research is funded by NHMRC instead.

grants.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships (Standard)
grants.funding_body: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
grants.description: Brings international postdocs to Japanese host institutions for collaborative research.
grants.eligibility: PhD within last 6 years; non-Japanese; Japanese host researcher required
grants.notes: Applications submitted by the Japanese host, not the fellow.

grants.title: Israel Science Foundation (ISF) Personal Research Grants
grants.description: Israel's central competitive fund for investigator-initiated basic research.
grants.eligibility: Faculty at eligible Israeli institutions
grants.notes: Various tracks incl. equipment and workshops.

grants.title: Villum Young Investigator Programme
grants.description: Helps talented young researchers establish independent research groups at Danish institutions.
grants.eligibility: 2–8 yrs post-PhD; hosted at a Danish university
grants.notes: Part of the broader Villum/Velux foundation family.

grants.title: Carlsberg Foundation Fellowships & Grants
grants.description: Internationalisation fellowships, reintegration fellowships and research infrastructure grants.
grants.eligibility: Ties to Danish research environment required (varies by scheme)
grants.notes: Strong support for early-career mobility to/from Denmark.

grants.title: Wallenberg Academy Fellows
grants.description: Sweden's largest private career programme for young researchers, with 5+5 year funding.
grants.eligibility: Nomination by Swedish universities only — no direct applications
grants.notes: Talk to your Swedish host university's research office about nomination.

grants.title: Research Ireland Pathway Programme
grants.description: Supports early-career researchers to establish independent careers at Irish institutions.
grants.eligibility: Typically 3–8 yrs post-PhD; hosted at eligible Irish research body
grants.notes: SFI and IRC merged into Research Ireland in 2024 — older links may redirect.

grants.title: Grand Challenges (Gates Foundation)
grants.description: Family of initiatives funding innovative solutions to global health and development challenges.
grants.eligibility: Open per specific challenge call; org must be eligible
grants.deadline_text: Rolling series of topic calls (check site)
grants.notes: Watch for topic-specific calls throughout the year.

grants.title: John Templeton Foundation Grants
grants.description: Funds research on 'big questions' across sciences and humanities via letter-of-inquiry process.
grants.eligibility: Via eligible organisations; fit with funding areas required
grants.deadline_text: Annual LOI window (typically mid-Aug–Oct; check site)
grants.notes: Check current funding priorities before applying.

grants.title: AXA Research Fund
grants.description: Funds fellowships and chairs on risk-related topics via campaigns announced through institutions.
grants.eligibility: Via eligible institutions; campaigns announced periodically
grants.notes: Institutions often pre-select candidates internally.

grants.title: 'la Caixa' Junior Leader Fellowships
grants.description: Attracts international postdocs to top Spanish and Portuguese research centres, with generous conditions.
grants.eligibility: PhD 2–7 yrs before deadline; mobility rule applies; two strands (Incoming/Retaining)
grants.notes: One of Europe's best-paid postdoc programmes.

grants.title: NIH Pathway to Independence Award (K99/R00)
grants.region: USA (K99 phase; R00 portable to US institutions)
grants.description: Two-phase award: 1–2 mentored postdoc years (K99) then up to 3 independent years (R00) at a US institution.
grants.eligibility: ≤4 yrs postdoc experience at application; no citizenship requirement (unusual for K awards)
grants.notes: One of few NIH career awards open to non-US citizens.

grants.title: NSF CAREER Award
grants.description: NSF's most prestigious early-career award, integrating research and education for junior faculty.
grants.eligibility: Tenure-track (or equivalent) assistant professor at eligible US institution; ≤3 attempts
grants.notes: Deadline and rules set in the current CAREER solicitation.

grants.title: FWF Erwin Schrödinger Fellowship
grants.description: Sends highly qualified postdocs from Austria abroad (10–24 months) with an optional funded return phase at an Austrian institution.
grants.amount: €30,000–36,700/yr abroad (tax-free, country-dependent) + return phase at senior-postdoc salary + up to €15k project costs
grants.duration: 10–24 months abroad + up to 12 months return
grants.eligibility: Doctorate completed; based in Austria ≥3 of last 10 yrs (or 2 yrs continuous research in Austria); must return to Austrian science
grants.notes: Fellowship abroad may only be held once. Verified 14 Jul 2026.

grants.title: ÖAW DOC Fellowship
grants.description: Austria's flagship doctoral fellowship: funds excellent PhD candidates at Austrian universities to complete their dissertation.
grants.eligibility: Master's completed ≤2 yrs before application; enrolled (or eligible) for doctoral studies at an Austrian university; no multi-year contract funding
grants.notes: One re-application allowed. Verified 14 Jul 2026.

grants.title: ÖAW Post-DocTrack
grants.description: Bridging fellowship for doctoral candidates in the final phase, to finish the dissertation without financial pressure.
grants.eligibility: Doctoral candidates at Austrian universities close to completing the dissertation
grants.notes: Bridges the gap between PhD completion and first postdoc position.

grants.title: OeAD Ernst Mach Grant
grants.funding_body: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
grants.description: Brings international doctoral candidates and young postdocs to Austrian universities for research stays.
grants.eligibility: Non-Austrian researchers; age/degree limits vary by track (e.g. worldwide track for postdocs ≤35)
grants.notes: Several tracks (worldwide, specific countries). Listed on grants.at.

grants.title: OeAD Marietta Blau Grant
grants.description: Funds Austrian doctoral candidates to spend 6–12 months of their PhD research abroad.
grants.eligibility: Doctoral candidates at Austrian universities in the second half of their PhD; excellent record
grants.notes: For the outgoing half of Austrian PhD mobility. Listed on grants.at.

grants.title: OeNB Anniversary Fund (Jubiläumsfonds)
grants.description: The Austrian central bank's fund for research projects, a classic first-PI grant for postdocs in its thematic areas.
grants.eligibility: Project leader with doctorate at an Austrian research institution; thematic fit required
grants.notes: Popular first grant for postdocs in economics, medicine, and social sciences.

grants.title: WWTF Vienna Research Groups for Young Investigators
grants.description: Brings outstanding young researchers from abroad to Vienna to establish their first independent research group.
grants.eligibility: Typically 2–8 yrs post-PhD; currently abroad; Viennese host institution required; thematic call areas rotate
grants.notes: One of Austria's most generous early-career packages; Vienna-specific.

grants.title: Seal of Excellence Postdoc Fellowship @ ÖAW
grants.description: Funds postdocs who earned a Seal of Excellence in the MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships call but missed EU funding, to carry out the project at an ÖAW institute.
grants.duration: Up to 24 months (as in MSCA proposal)
grants.eligibility: Seal of Excellence from the previous MSCA-PF call; project hosted at an ÖAW institute
grants.deadline_text: Annual (2025-call SoE holders: 31 Mar 2026; check site)
grants.application_mode: Email application to ÖAW grant service
grants.notes: Great fallback if your MSCA application scored well but wasn't funded. Verified 14 Jul 2026.

grants.title: FWF 1000 Ideas Programme
grants.description: Seed funding for daring, unconventional research ideas too risky for regular programmes; anonymized review process.
grants.eligibility: Doctorate; project at an Austrian research institution; idea must be genuinely high-risk/high-gain
grants.notes: Double-blind evaluation — track record plays no role. Good for postdocs with bold ideas.

grants.title: ÖAW APART-GSK Fellowships
grants.description: 3-year postdoc fellowships giving young researchers in the humanities, social and cultural sciences time for a major independent project at an Austrian institution.
grants.eligibility: PhD completed (typically ≤5 yrs); project at Austrian research institution
grants.notes: One of Austria's best-paid postdoc fellowships in GSK fields.

grants.title: Max Kade Fellowships (via ÖAW)
grants.category: Natural sciences, medicine, engineering, social sciences
grants.description: Funds a research year at a US university for young Austrian-based scientists, with return perspective.
grants.eligibility: PhD completed recently; affiliation with Austrian institution; US host required
grants.notes: Classic outgoing US postdoc route for Austrians.
grants.category_clean: Life Sciences & Medicine;Natural Sciences & Engineering;Social Sciences & Humanities

grants.title: L'Oréal Austria For Women in Science Fellowships
grants.description: Fellowships for young women scientists in Austria to start or continue doctoral/postdoc research.
grants.eligibility: Women in medicine, natural sciences or math at Austrian institutions; age/career limits per call
grants.notes: Administered through the ÖAW fellowship office.

grants.title: Austrian Marshall Plan Foundation Scholarships
grants.description: Funds research stays of Austrian students/doctoral candidates at US universities and vice versa.
grants.eligibility: Enrolled at Austrian university (or US partner); research stay abroad, mainly technical/scientific fields
grants.notes: Popular for PhD research visits to US labs.

grants.title: Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
grants.description: Canada's most prestigious postdoc award, attracting top national and international talent to Canadian institutions.
grants.eligibility: PhD within eligibility window; Canadian host institution; nationals of any country
grants.notes: Host institution endorsement is decisive.

grants.title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
grants.description: Canada's flagship doctoral scholarship for high-calibre Canadian and international PhD students.
grants.eligibility: Nominated by the Canadian university where you pursue the PhD
grants.notes: Apply through the university's internal deadline (earlier!).

grants.title: NWO Rubicon
grants.description: Enables recently graduated Dutch-based researchers to gain experience at top institutions abroad.
grants.eligibility: PhD within 1 year (or near completion) at Dutch institution; research abroad
grants.notes: Counterpart to Veni for the outgoing phase.

grants.title: Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851 Research Fellowships
grants.funding_body: Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851
grants.description: Prestigious UK fellowships giving early-career scientists and engineers freedom to pursue their own research.
grants.eligibility: PhD ≤3 yrs (or about to complete); UK host institution
grants.notes: Small, highly selective scheme with strong alumni network.

grants.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
grants.funding_body: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
grants.description: Research scholarships for foreign researchers at Swiss universities, ETH domain and universities of applied sciences.
grants.eligibility: Non-Swiss nationals; Swiss host professor required; country list applies
grants.deadline_text: Annual (via Swiss embassy in your country; autumn deadlines)
grants.notes: Deadlines vary by country of origin.

grants.title: Chateaubriand Fellowship (STEM)
grants.funding_body: Embassy of France in the United States
grants.description: Funds US-based PhD students to conduct research in French laboratories for 4–9 months.
grants.eligibility: PhD students enrolled at US institutions; French host lab
grants.notes: Also a humanities/social science track.

grants.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
grants.funding_body: Campus France (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs)
grants.description: France's flagship scholarship attracting international students into French master's and PhD programmes.
grants.eligibility: Non-French nationals; nominated by the French host institution
grants.notes: Apply through the French university, not directly.

grants.title: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
grants.description: Fully funded PhD in science and engineering at Singapore's universities and A*STAR research institutes.
grants.eligibility: International students; strong academic record; STEM fields
grants.deadline_text: 2 intakes/yr (1 Jun & 1 Dec deadlines; check site)
grants.notes: Covers biomedical, physical sciences and engineering.

grants.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
grants.funding_body: Research Grants Council of Hong Kong
grants.description: Prestigious fellowships attracting top international students to PhD programmes at Hong Kong universities.
grants.eligibility: New full-time PhD applicants at Hong Kong institutions
grants.notes: Apply in parallel to the university programme.

grants.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarships
grants.description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding international students to pursue postgraduate degrees at Cambridge.
grants.eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge
grants.deadline_text: With Cambridge application (Oct–Jan deadlines; check site)
grants.notes: Apply via the normal Cambridge course application.

grants.title: Azrieli International Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.description: Brings outstanding international postdocs to Israeli universities, with generous funding and community programme.
grants.eligibility: International researchers; Israeli host institution; PhD within eligibility window
grants.notes: One of Israel's best-funded incoming postdoc routes.

grants.title: Zuckerman STEM Leadership Program (Postdoctoral)
grants.description: Brings high-achieving American (and other) STEM postdocs to Israeli universities.
grants.eligibility: STEM PhDs, primarily from North American institutions; Israeli host university
grants.notes: Strong alumni network across US–Israel science.

grants.title: FFG BRIDGE Programme
grants.description: Funds cooperative projects between Austrian research institutions and companies, bridging basic research toward application.
grants.eligibility: Austrian research institution + company partner; scientific lead at the institution
grants.notes: Good route for scientists whose basic research is nearing application.

grants.title: FFG Spin-off Fellowships
grants.description: Pays researchers' salaries for up to 18 months to turn academic research results into a company spin-off.
grants.eligibility: Researchers at Austrian institutions with commercialisable results; institution supports IP transfer
grants.notes: For scientists exploring the startup path without leaving research.

grants.title: FFG Industry-Related Dissertations (Industrienahe Dissertationen)
grants.description: Funds PhD dissertations carried out jointly with Austrian companies on applied research topics.
grants.eligibility: PhD at Austrian institution with participating company; topic with application relevance
grants.notes: Check the current call name on FFG's site — programme labels change between years.

grants.title: aws Preseed – Deep Tech
grants.description: Austria's main pre-seed grant for research-intensive deep-tech startups before or shortly after founding.
grants.eligibility: Deep-tech startup (pre-)founding in Austria; innovative, research-based concept
grants.notes: Classic first money for academic founders in Austria.

grants.title: aws Seedfinancing – Deep Tech
grants.description: Follow-on seed funding for young Austrian deep-tech companies scaling toward market entry.
grants.eligibility: Austrian startup typically <6 yrs old; deep-tech focus; co-financing required
grants.notes: Natural successor to aws Preseed.

grants.title: EIC Accelerator
grants.description: The EU's flagship for breakthrough startups: grant plus optional equity investment from the EIC Fund.
grants.eligibility: Single startups/SMEs in EU/Associated Countries; high-risk, high-impact innovation
grants.deadline_text: Full-proposal deadline 2 Sep 2026 (next batch 4 Nov 2026); short proposal any time
grants.application_mode: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (short proposal → full → interview)
grants.notes: 2026 budget: €414M Open + €220M Challenges. Short proposals anytime (batched first Tuesday monthly), full proposals to fixed batch dates, then EIC Jury interview. One live application at a time. Verified 23 Jul 2026.

grants.title: EIC Transition
grants.description: Matures results from ERC PoC / Pathfinder projects toward market, funding both technology and venture development.
grants.eligibility: Builds on eligible prior EU project results; single entities or small consortia
grants.notes: The bridge from academic results to a fundable company.

grants.title: Eurostars (EUREKA)
grants.description: Funds transnational R&D projects led by innovative SMEs, paid out through national agencies (FFG in Austria).
grants.amount: Country-dependent (AT: grant via FFG, typically up to ~50% of costs)
grants.eligibility: SME-led consortium from ≥2 Eurostars countries
grants.notes: Good odds compared to EIC; requires an international partner.

grants.title: EIT Community Accelerators (Health, Digital, Climate, ...)
grants.description: The EIT's thematic communities run accelerators, bootcamps and grant calls for startups in health, digital, climate, food, manufacturing and more.
grants.eligibility: Startup matching the thematic community; EU presence
grants.notes: Pick the community matching your field (EIT Health for life-science founders etc.).

grants.title: ESA BIC Austria
grants.funding_body: European Space Agency / brimatech, Science Park Graz
grants.description: ESA's business incubation centre for startups using space technology or serving the space sector — hosted in Graz and Vienna.
grants.eligibility: Startup <5 yrs using space tech/data; Austrian location
grants.notes: Science Park Graz runs the Graz location.

grants.title: AplusB Academic Incubators (Science Park Graz, INiTS, ...)
grants.description: Austria's academic business incubators supporting researchers and students turning science into startups, with funding, coaching and infrastructure.
grants.eligibility: Academic founders (students, graduates, researchers); regional centre application
grants.deadline_text: Rolling / batch intakes (check your regional centre)
grants.notes: In Graz: Science Park Graz; in Vienna: INiTS.

grants.title: Vienna Business Agency Funding (Wirtschaftsagentur Wien)
grants.description: The City of Vienna's funding programmes for startups and companies — innovation projects, founding support, creative industries.
grants.eligibility: Company/startup based in Vienna (or relocating there)
grants.notes: Only for Vienna-based ventures — location matters.

grants.title: Steirische Wirtschaftsförderung (SFG) Start-up Funding
grants.description: Styria's business promotion agency funds founders and young innovative companies in the region — grants, consulting subsidies and growth support.
grants.eligibility: Company/startup located in Styria
grants.notes: Relevant for Graz-based founders; programmes change, check current lineup.

grants.title: WKO Gründerservice & Founding Support
grants.description: The Chambers' founder service: free consulting, founding formalities, and pointers to bonuses and micro-grants for new businesses.
grants.amount: Mostly services; small bonuses vary by province
grants.eligibility: Anyone founding a business in Austria
grants.notes: Best first stop to map which Austrian funding fits your founding stage.

grants.title: FFG General Programme (Basisprogramm)
grants.description: FFG's biggest programme: funds companies' R&D projects — startups included — with a grant/loan mix, submitted any time.
grants.amount: Grant + soft loan mix (projects up to ~€3M)
grants.eligibility: Company conducting R&D in Austria; startups welcome
grants.notes: High acceptance rate; the workhorse of Austrian applied R&D funding.

grants.title: EIC Pre-Accelerator
grants.description: Raises the business, investor and technology readiness of early-stage deep-tech startups in widening countries (TRL 4-6), with a fast track into the EIC Accelerator.
grants.amount: €500k-1M lump sum in the 2027 call (€300-500k in 2025), covering 70% of costs
grants.eligibility: Single SMEs registered in Horizon Europe widening countries ONLY - Austrian, German, French etc. companies are not eligible. TRL 4+, own IP, clear route to market
grants.notes: Eligible countries: BG, HR, CY, CZ, EE, GR, HU, LV, LT, MT, PL, PT, RO, SK, SI plus associated widening countries. Includes free Business Acceleration Services and a Seal of Excellence. Verified 23 Jul 2026.

grants.title: EIC STEP Scale Up
grants.description: Large-ticket investment for European deep-tech companies scaling critical technologies, well beyond the standard EIC Accelerator ceiling.
grants.eligibility: European scale-ups working on STEP priority technologies (deep tech, clean tech, biotech)
grants.application_mode: EU Funding & Tenders Portal / EIC Fund
grants.notes: Since June 2026 the EIC also invests in defence and dual-use technologies through a separate STEP Scale Up Defence strand.

grants.title: European Prize for Women Innovators
grants.description: Annual EU prize recognising outstanding women entrepreneurs behind innovative companies, including a Rising Innovators category for younger founders.
grants.eligibility: Women founders or co-founders of a company registered in the EU or an Associated Country
grants.notes: Prize money rather than project funding, but strong visibility for later fundraising.

grants.title: EIC Business Acceleration Services (BAS)
grants.description: Free coaching, mentoring, investor matchmaking and partnering for companies and projects already supported by the EIC.
grants.eligibility: Open to EIC-supported companies and projects (Pathfinder, Transition, Accelerator, Pre-Accelerator)
grants.notes: Worth weighing when comparing EIC schemes against national funding.

grants.title: EIT Digital Co-Creation Accelerator
grants.description: Four-month programme developing early-stage digital solutions together with industry partners, with funding attached.
grants.eligibility: Early-stage digital or deep-tech teams (TRL 4-5) in the EIT Digital ecosystem
grants.notes: Application window open right now, closing September 2026. Verified 23 Jul 2026.

grants.title: EIT Digital Venture Incubation Programme
grants.description: Takes entrepreneurs from concept to MVP, market validation and funding in under a year, with a small grant plus optional follow-on investment.
grants.eligibility: Founders with an early digital or deep-tech idea; EIT Digital ecosystem
grants.notes: Small money but a structured path and network - a sensible very first step.

grants.title: EIT Digital SPIN (Explore & Rise)
grants.description: Free pre-incubation for deep-tech researchers: SPIN Explore is a 9-hour online course on innovation readiness and IP, SPIN Rise a 9-week hybrid programme with mentoring and business model development.
grants.eligibility: Deep-tech researchers and early-career academics in Europe
grants.notes: An ideal bridge for scientists weighing commercialisation - costs nothing but time.

grants.title: SPEX Venture Health-Tech Fund
grants.description: A €100M fund investing in the next generation of digital healthcare and med-tech companies.
grants.eligibility: Seed to Series A digital health or med-tech startups
grants.notes: Equity investment rather than a grant: dilutive, but far larger tickets.

grants.title: EUDOROS Open Call (Cybersecurity)
grants.description: Cascade-funding call for cybersecurity service providers and tool creators to deploy their solutions with new customers.
grants.eligibility: Cybersecurity SMEs and tool providers in eligible countries
grants.notes: Closing soon. Cascade funding (financial support to third parties) is much less competitive than the main EU calls. Verified 23 Jul 2026.

grants.title: RIVCircular Open Call (Circular Economy)
grants.description: Cascade funding for circular-economy projects across construction, textiles, electric vehicles, waste-to-resource and digital technologies.
grants.eligibility: Research and industry stakeholders in the participating European innovation ecosystems
grants.notes: Verified 23 Jul 2026.

grants.title: UNITE Open Call (Digital Health)
grants.description: Fast-tracks digital health startups tackling ageing populations and demographic change, with funding plus market-entry support.
grants.eligibility: Digital health startups able to scale across European markets
grants.notes: One of the larger cascade-funding opportunities for health tech.

grants.title: LLM-BRIDGE Open Call (Generative AI)
grants.description: Pan-European programme creating and growing European generative-AI ventures, with incubation funding and free support services.
grants.eligibility: Early-stage European generative-AI ventures
grants.notes: Part of the EIT Digital ecosystem; check the current round for exact dates.

grants.title: CEEPUS (Central European Exchange Programme for University Studies)
grants.description: Multilateral exchange programme funding study and research stays across 16 Central and Eastern European countries, either within university networks or as a 'freemover'.
grants.amount: Monthly scholarship set by the host country (Austria: ~€1,250/mo for PhD level) + often waived fees
grants.eligibility: Students, doctoral candidates and academic staff at participating universities in CEEPUS member countries
grants.deadline_text: Network applications ~15 Jun; freemover deadlines vary by country (check site)
grants.notes: Underused route for short research stays in the region; freemover track needs no network membership.

grants.title: Aktion Austria–Czech Republic / Slovakia / Hungary
grants.description: Bilateral programmes funding research and study stays between Austria and Czechia, Slovakia or Hungary, in both directions, plus small cooperative projects.
grants.amount: Monthly scholarship (~€1,150–1,250) or project funding for travel/accommodation
grants.eligibility: Students, doctoral candidates and researchers at universities in Austria and the respective partner country
grants.notes: Three parallel programmes with near-identical rules — check the one matching your partner country.

grants.title: Richard Plaschka Fellowship
grants.funding_body: OeAD on behalf of the BMFWF
grants.description: Research fellowships for foreign university teachers and researchers to carry out a research stay at an Austrian institution.
grants.eligibility: Non-Austrian university teachers and researchers; host institution in Austria required
grants.notes: Open worldwide; aimed at researchers already holding a university position.

grants.title: Ernst Mach Follow-up Grant
grants.description: Return grant enabling former Ernst Mach scholarship holders from developing countries to come back to Austria for a further research stay.
grants.eligibility: Former Ernst Mach grantees from non-European developing countries
grants.notes: Only open to alumni of the main Ernst Mach programme.

grants.title: Ernst Mach – ASEA-UNINET Short-term Research Grant
grants.description: Short research stays in Austria for researchers from ASEA-UNINET partner universities in Southeast Asia.
grants.eligibility: Researchers at ASEA-UNINET member universities (Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam)
grants.notes: Requires an Austrian host institute; nomination usually via the home university.

grants.title: Ernst Mach Grant – Ukraine
grants.description: Dedicated Ernst Mach strand supporting Ukrainian students and researchers to study or carry out research in Austria.
grants.eligibility: Ukrainian nationals; conditions per current call
grants.notes: Conditions have changed between rounds — check the current call text carefully.

grants.title: Indonesia–Austria Scholarship Programme (IASP)
grants.description: Joint programme funding Indonesian doctoral candidates to complete a PhD at an Austrian university.
grants.eligibility: Indonesian nationals admitted to an Austrian doctoral programme
grants.notes: Co-funded scheme; requires acceptance by the Austrian host university first.

grants.title: Franz Werfel Fellowship
grants.funding_body: OeAD on behalf of the BMFWF
grants.description: Fellowship for young university teachers of German language and Austrian literature to conduct research in Austria, with a long-term alumni network.
grants.eligibility: Young university teachers of German/Austrian literature; typically under 35; non-Austrian
grants.notes: Includes alumni follow-up grants and conference invitations after the fellowship.

grants.title: Erhard Busek Grant (Danube Region)
grants.funding_body: OeAD on behalf of the BMFWF
grants.description: Scholarship for students and young researchers from Danube region countries to study or research in Austria.
grants.eligibility: Nationals of eligible Danube region countries; admission to an Austrian institution
grants.notes: Named after the former Austrian vice-chancellor; focused on regional academic ties.

grants.title: ISTA Summer Fellowship (via OeAD)
grants.funding_body: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
grants.description: Paid summer research placement in a research group at ISTA — biology, neuroscience, physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science and data science.
grants.eligibility: Undergraduate and Master students with strong science background; international applicants welcome
grants.notes: Excellent stepping stone into a PhD at ISTA or elsewhere.

grants.title: Doctoral Grant for the European University Institute (EUI)
grants.funding_body: OeAD on behalf of the BMFWF
grants.category: Social sciences (economics, law, history, political & social sciences)
grants.description: Funds Austrian doctoral candidates to complete their PhD at the European University Institute in Florence.
grants.amount: Monthly grant (EUI standard rate) + travel + insurance
grants.eligibility: Austrian citizens (or equivalent) admitted to an EUI doctoral programme
grants.notes: You apply to the EUI first; the Austrian grant covers admitted national candidates.

grants.title: Scientific Stays at Taiwanese Universities
grants.description: Funds research stays at Taiwanese universities for doctoral candidates, lecturers and researchers based in Austria.
grants.eligibility: Doctoral candidates, lecturers and researchers at Austrian institutions; Taiwanese host required
grants.notes: Useful and under-applied route to Asian research collaborations.

grants.title: OeAD Bilateral Project Funding (Scientific & Technological Cooperation, WTZ)
grants.funding_body: OeAD on behalf of the BMFWF
grants.description: Funds cross-border scientific project cooperation under bilateral agreements and multilateral networks — primarily covering travel and accommodation for exchange visits.
grants.amount: Travel and accommodation costs (typically €5k–20k per project)
grants.eligibility: Researchers at Austrian institutions with a partner in the respective country
grants.notes: Small budgets but a low-friction way to seed international collaborations.

grants.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
grants.description: The most prestigious US graduate fellowship, supporting outstanding students in NSF-supported STEM and social science fields early in their doctoral studies.
grants.eligibility: US citizens, nationals or permanent residents; at most one year of graduate study completed
grants.deadline_text: Annual, typically mid/late Oct by field (check site)
grants.notes: Not open to international students — a common misconception. Applications are field-specific with staggered October deadlines.

grants.title: NIH Ruth L. Kirschstein NRSA Predoctoral Fellowship (F31)
grants.description: Individual predoctoral fellowships supporting promising doctoral students conducting dissertation research in health-related fields.
grants.eligibility: Enrolled in a US doctoral programme; US citizen or permanent resident for most F31 mechanisms
grants.notes: A separate F31 Diversity mechanism has its own eligibility. Strongly boosts later career awards.

grants.title: NIH Ruth L. Kirschstein NRSA Postdoctoral Fellowship (F32)
grants.description: Individual postdoctoral fellowships giving new PhDs protected time and mentored training in health-related research.
grants.amount: Stipend by experience level (~$56-70k) + institutional allowance
grants.eligibility: PhD/MD completed; US citizen or permanent resident; US host institution
grants.notes: Citizenship requirement — international postdocs should look at K99/R00 or private foundations instead.

grants.title: NIH Research Project Grant (R01)
grants.description: The backbone of US biomedical funding: investigator-initiated project grants supporting a discrete, specified research project.
grants.eligibility: Independent investigator at an eligible institution; no citizenship requirement
grants.deadline_text: Standard dates: 5 Feb, 5 Jun, 5 Oct (new applications)
grants.notes: Open to foreign institutions in some cases. The single most important grant in US biomedical careers.

grants.title: NIH Exploratory/Developmental Research Grant (R21)
grants.description: Supports early-stage, high-risk exploratory projects that may lead to a breakthrough — no preliminary data required.
grants.eligibility: Independent investigator at an eligible institution
grants.notes: Good entry point for a new direction; not all NIH institutes accept unsolicited R21s.

grants.title: NSF Postdoctoral Research Fellowships
grants.description: Directorate-specific postdoctoral fellowships (biology, maths, earth sciences, astronomy, computing, social sciences) supporting independent research and training.
grants.eligibility: Recent PhD; US citizen/permanent resident for most programmes; check each solicitation
grants.notes: Each NSF directorate runs its own scheme with different rules — read the specific solicitation.

grants.title: Ford Foundation Fellowship Programs
grants.funding_body: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
grants.description: Predoctoral, dissertation and postdoctoral fellowships for scholars committed to diversity in higher education across all fields.
grants.eligibility: US citizens/nationals/permanent residents and certain others; planning a teaching/research career
grants.notes: Highly regarded; strong alumni network across US academia.

grants.title: Hertz Fellowship
grants.category: Applied physical sciences, engineering, maths & life sciences
grants.description: Perhaps the most generous and selective US PhD fellowship, giving five years of funding and unusual research freedom to applied-science students.
grants.eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents beginning or early in a PhD at a participating institution
grants.notes: Interviews are famously demanding technical problem-solving sessions.

grants.title: Damon Runyon Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.description: Supports exceptionally creative early postdocs pursuing cancer-related basic and translational research under leading mentors.
grants.amount: ~$70k/yr rising, plus retirement of up to $100k in student debt
grants.eligibility: PhD/MD within eligibility window; US host institution; any nationality
grants.notes: Open to international applicants at US institutions — rare and valuable. Includes loan repayment.

grants.title: Life Sciences Research Foundation (LSRF) Fellowship
grants.description: Prestigious postdoctoral fellowships across the entire breadth of the life sciences, funded by a consortium of sponsors.
grants.eligibility: PhD/MD, typically within 5 years; open to all nationalities; host usually in the US
grants.notes: One of the few top US postdoc fellowships genuinely open to non-US citizens.

grants.title: Jane Coffin Childs Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.funding_body: Jane Coffin Childs Fund for Medical Research
grants.description: Long-standing fellowship supporting postdocs in fundamental biomedical research, with unusual freedom to follow the science.
grants.eligibility: PhD/MD within eligibility window; any nationality; host lab anywhere (mostly US)
grants.notes: Now partnered with HHMI, increasing award levels.

grants.title: Helen Hay Whitney Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.description: Supports early postdoctoral training in all basic biomedical sciences, with an emphasis on candidates changing fields.
grants.eligibility: PhD/MD, no more than ~1 year of postdoc experience; any nationality
grants.notes: Encourages ambitious changes of research direction between PhD and postdoc.

grants.title: Burroughs Wellcome Career Awards at the Scientific Interface
grants.description: Bridges postdoc and faculty for researchers bringing physical, mathematical or computational approaches into biology.
grants.eligibility: PhD in a physical/computational discipline; postdoc window applies; US or Canadian institution
grants.notes: Excellent for physicists, mathematicians and computer scientists moving into life science.

grants.title: Searle Scholars Program
grants.description: Supports exceptional young faculty in their first independent position pursuing biomedical and chemical research.
grants.eligibility: First-year tenure-track assistant professors at ~180 invited US institutions
grants.notes: Institution-nominated: talk to your dean's office early, internal deadlines come first.

grants.title: Pew Scholars Program in the Biomedical Sciences
grants.description: Funds promising early-career biomedical scientists whose work is creative and takes intellectual risks.
grants.eligibility: Assistant professors within eligibility window; nominated by invited US institutions
grants.notes: Also runs the Pew Latin American Fellows programme for postdocs from Latin America.

grants.title: Beckman Young Investigator Program
grants.description: Supports young faculty pursuing inventive, high-risk research in chemistry and the life sciences, especially new methods and instrumentation.
grants.eligibility: Tenure-track faculty within first ~4 years at a US institution
grants.notes: Strong fit for tool-builders and instrument developers.

grants.title: Sloan Research Fellowships
grants.category: Chemistry, physics, maths, neuroscience, computational & earth sciences, economics
grants.description: One of the most prestigious US early-career honours, recognising rising research leaders in seven fields.
grants.eligibility: Tenure-track faculty, typically within 6 years of PhD; nomination by a department head required
grants.notes: Requires nomination by your department — ask your chair well in advance.

grants.title: Packard Fellowships for Science and Engineering
grants.description: Highly flexible, unrestricted funding for early-career professors in the natural sciences and engineering.
grants.eligibility: Assistant professors in first three years; two nominations per invited university
grants.notes: Only 50 invited universities may nominate; internal competition is the real hurdle.

grants.title: DOE Office of Science Graduate Student Research (SCGSR)
grants.description: Sends US doctoral students to DOE national laboratories to conduct thesis research alongside laboratory scientists.
grants.eligibility: US citizens/permanent residents in a US PhD programme; DOE lab collaborator required
grants.notes: Superb access to national-lab instrumentation not available at universities.

grants.title: DOE Early Career Research Program
grants.description: Supports outstanding early-career researchers at US universities and DOE national laboratories in Office of Science areas.
grants.amount: ~$875k over 5 years (university); higher at national labs
grants.eligibility: Within ~10 years of PhD; untenured or lab equivalent; US institution
grants.notes: Strong route for physics, materials, fusion, computing and climate researchers.

grants.title: NASA Postdoctoral Program (NPP)
grants.description: Competitive postdoctoral fellowships at NASA centres and affiliated institutes across the full range of NASA science and technology.
grants.eligibility: PhD within 5 years; US citizens, permanent residents and eligible foreign nationals
grants.notes: Open to international applicants (visa route available) — unusual for US federal programmes.

grants.title: NSF SBIR/STTR (America's Seed Fund)
grants.description: America's Seed Fund: non-dilutive funding for US startups commercialising high-risk technology, from proof of concept through prototype.
grants.amount: Phase I up to $305,000; Phase II up to $1,000,000 (+ supplements)
grants.duration: Phase I 6-12 months; Phase II 24 months
grants.eligibility: US-based, majority US-owned small business (<500 employees); no prior sales of the technology required
grants.deadline_text: Rolling: Project Pitch required first, then invited full proposal
grants.notes: Start with the 3-page Project Pitch — you get a go/no-go in ~3 weeks before writing anything long.

grants.title: NIH SBIR/STTR
grants.description: The largest source of early-stage non-dilutive funding for US health and biotech startups, across all NIH institutes.
grants.amount: Phase I ~$300k; Phase II ~$2M (higher for approved topics)
grants.duration: Phase I 6-12 months; Phase II 2 years
grants.eligibility: US small business; PI primary employment with the company (SBIR) or research institution partner (STTR)
grants.notes: NIH is the single biggest SBIR funder — over $1.2B a year.

grants.title: DOE SBIR/STTR
grants.description: Non-dilutive funding for US small businesses developing energy, climate and advanced-manufacturing technologies.
grants.duration: Phase I 6-12 months; Phase II 2 years
grants.eligibility: US-based small business; topics set per annual solicitation
grants.deadline_text: Annual cycles with letters of intent (check site)
grants.notes: Topics are published in advance — align your pitch to a named topic.

grants.title: NSF I-Corps
grants.description: Immersive customer-discovery training that helps academic teams decide whether their research can become a business.
grants.eligibility: Academic teams with a technology and a lineage to federally funded research; regional hubs also run free short courses
grants.notes: The single best first step for a scientist wondering whether to found a company.

grants.title: ARPA-E OPEN and Focused Programs
grants.description: Funds high-potential, high-impact energy technologies too early for private investment, across startups and academic teams.
grants.eligibility: US-based entities; teams may include universities and companies
grants.deadline_text: OPEN calls periodically; focused programmes rolling (check site)
grants.notes: Concept paper stage first; strong preference for credible techno-economic analysis.

grants.title: Activate Fellowship (incl. Cyclotron Road)
grants.funding_body: Activate (Berkeley, Boston, Houston, New York, Anywhere)
grants.description: Two-year fellowship paying scientists a salary to mature a hard-tech idea into a company, hosted at national labs and partner institutions.
grants.amount: ~$100k+/yr stipend + up to $100k research budget + benefits
grants.eligibility: Scientists and engineers with a hard-tech concept; PhD or equivalent experience typical
grants.notes: The premier US route from lab bench to hard-tech startup; keeps you out of the funding gap.

grants.title: EXIST Business Start-up Grant (EXIST-Gründerstipendium)
grants.funding_body: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs (BMWK)
grants.description: Germany's flagship pre-formation grant: pays founders a salary while they turn a university or research idea into a business plan.
grants.amount: Up to ~€3,000/month per founder + €30,000 materials + €5,000 coaching
grants.eligibility: Teams of up to 3 from a German university or research institution; company not yet founded
grants.deadline_text: Rolling submission via the host university
grants.interview: Yes — pitch to the host institution
grants.notes: The single best-known route for German academic founders. Your university's transfer office submits it.

grants.title: EXIST Research Transfer (EXIST-Forschungstransfer)
grants.funding_body: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs (BMWK)
grants.description: Two-phase programme funding the technical development and then the market entry of research-intensive spin-offs from German institutions.
grants.amount: Phase 1 up to ~€250,000 (staff + materials); Phase 2 co-financed follow-on
grants.duration: Phase 1 up to 18 months; Phase 2 18 months
grants.eligibility: Research teams at German universities/institutes with a technically demanding, high-risk innovation
grants.notes: The bigger sibling of the EXIST stipend, for deep-tech needing further technical work.

grants.title: GO-Bio and GO-Bio initial
grants.funding_body: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)
grants.description: Funds life-science research ideas with commercial potential, from exploring an idea (GO-Bio initial) through to building a company (GO-Bio).
grants.amount: GO-Bio initial ~€100-150k per phase; GO-Bio up to €2M+
grants.eligibility: Researchers at German institutions with a life-science idea aiming at translation
grants.deadline_text: Two cut-offs per year (typically Apr and Oct; check site)
grants.notes: GO-Bio initial is deliberately low-threshold: a good first test of a translational idea.

grants.title: KfW Zukunftsfonds / DeepTech & Climate Fonds
grants.description: Germany's public venture arm co-investing with private funds in scale-ups, with a dedicated deep-tech and climate vehicle.
grants.amount: DTCF: €10-100M equity; KfW co-investments up to ~€50M
grants.eligibility: German deep-tech or climate companies with proven technology and private lead investor
grants.notes: Requires a private lead investor — this is co-investment, not first money.

grants.title: Bourse French Tech Emergence (BFTE)
grants.description: Grant for very early deep-tech companies to fund feasibility work, prototyping and market validation.
grants.amount: Up to €90,000 (covering up to 70% of eligible costs)
grants.eligibility: French company under 1 year old, deep-tech, founder from research or with a strong technical innovation
grants.notes: One of the more accessible European pre-seed grants for research-based founders.

grants.title: Bourse French Tech Lab (BFT Lab)
grants.description: Supports researchers and lab teams before company creation, funding the maturation of a technology toward a spin-off.
grants.eligibility: Researchers at a French public research organisation preparing a spin-off; company not yet created
grants.notes: France's answer to EXIST — money before the company exists.

grants.title: France 2030 / French Tech 2030
grants.description: France's national investment plan, running calls across AI, quantum, health, energy, robotics and advanced manufacturing.
grants.amount: Highly variable (€100k to tens of millions)
grants.eligibility: Companies (and consortia) based in France; topic-specific eligibility
grants.notes: €1.5bn+/yr in startup-focused calls; watch for the topic that matches your sector.

grants.title: NEOTEC (CDTI)
grants.funding_body: Centre for the Development of Industrial Technology (CDTI)
grants.description: Spain's flagship non-repayable grant for young technology companies built on genuine R&D, with a bonus for teams including PhD holders.
grants.amount: Up to €250,000 (up to €325,000 with PhD staff); covers up to 70% of costs
grants.eligibility: Spanish company between 6 months and 3 years old, minimum €20,000 share capital, R&D-based
grants.notes: Non-repayable and takes no equity — one of the best-value startup grants in Europe. 2026 focus: deeptech, biotech, medtech, energy, materials, AI.

grants.title: CDTI R&D Project Loans (Proyectos de I+D)
grants.funding_body: Centre for the Development of Industrial Technology (CDTI)
grants.description: Partially forgivable soft loans covering the bulk of an R&D project's costs for Spanish companies including startups.
grants.amount: Up to 85% of project costs (partly non-repayable tranche)
grants.eligibility: Spanish companies conducting industrial research or experimental development
grants.notes: Rolling deadline and generous coverage — underused by startups who assume it is only for large firms.

grants.title: CDP Venture Capital (Fondo Nazionale Innovazione)
grants.description: Italy's national innovation fund, investing directly and through funds across the whole startup lifecycle.
grants.eligibility: Italian startups or startups relocating to Italy
grants.application_mode: Via the relevant CDP fund or accelerator
grants.notes: Runs many vertical accelerators; the entry point depends on your sector and stage.

grants.title: Smart&Start Italia
grants.description: Zero-interest loans (with a partial grant component in southern Italy) for innovative Italian startups.
grants.eligibility: Italian 'startup innovativa' registered less than 5 years
grants.notes: Zero-interest, no equity; extra grant share for companies in the Mezzogiorno.

grants.title: Vouchers for Startups (PRR)
grants.description: Fixed-amount vouchers helping Portuguese startups develop new digital and technology products, funded through the EU recovery plan.
grants.eligibility: Portuguese startups meeting the national startup definition
grants.notes: Simple fixed-sum instrument with lighter paperwork than most EU-funded grants.

grants.title: PARP Startup Booster / Eastern Poland Platforms
grants.description: Non-repayable seed funding helping Polish startups build and validate an MVP, with a dedicated Eastern Poland track covering 100% of costs.
grants.amount: Startup Booster up to ~PLN 400k (~€85k); Eastern Poland up to ~PLN 600k (~€130k)
grants.eligibility: Polish micro/small companies; regional restrictions for the Eastern Poland track
grants.notes: Structured as de-minimis aid, so it can be stacked with Eurostars or EU cascade grants.

grants.title: NCBR Fast Track (Ścieżka SMART)
grants.funding_body: National Centre for Research and Development (NCBR)
grants.description: Poland's main industrial R&D grant, funding company research projects from industrial research to experimental development.
grants.amount: Up to ~PLN 3M for SMEs (larger for consortia)
grants.eligibility: Companies conducting R&D in Poland; SMEs favoured in funding rates
grants.notes: Part of the FENG programme; among the largest national R&D budgets in the EU.

grants.title: WBSO R&D Tax Credit
grants.description: The Netherlands' central innovation instrument: a payroll tax credit on R&D wages, with an enhanced rate for young companies.
grants.amount: Up to ~50% credit on R&D wages; starters get an enhanced rate on the first ~€380,000
grants.eligibility: Any Dutch company (including one-person startups) performing qualifying R&D
grants.deadline_text: Rolling applications (apply before the period starts)
grants.notes: Not a grant but real cash flow — most Dutch tech startups use it from day one.

grants.title: RVO Innovation Credit (Innovatiekrediet)
grants.description: Risk-bearing loan for technically challenging development projects, repayable only if the project succeeds.
grants.amount: 35-45% of project costs (up to €5M technical / €10M clinical)
grants.eligibility: Dutch companies with a technically risky but promising development project
grants.notes: If the project fails technically, the loan is forgiven — genuinely risk-sharing.

grants.title: MIT — SME Innovation Stimulation Top Sectors
grants.category: Applied innovation (life sciences, green tech, digital)
grants.description: Regional and national scheme funding SME feasibility studies and collaborative R&D in the Dutch priority sectors.
grants.eligibility: Dutch SMEs; project must fit a designated top sector
grants.notes: Feasibility grants are often first-come-first-served — apply on opening day.

grants.title: EIT Urban Mobility Innovation Calls
grants.description: Funds innovation projects and startup programmes reshaping urban mobility across European cities.
grants.amount: Up to €2.5M per project (smaller startup instruments too)
grants.eligibility: Companies and consortia in EU/associated countries; city partner often required
grants.notes: One of nine EIT communities — check EIT Health, EIT Climate-KIC, EIT Food, EIT Manufacturing and others for your sector.

grants.title: InvestEU (via financial intermediaries)
grants.description: EU guarantee programme that lets national banks, funds and lenders offer better financing terms to innovative companies.
grants.amount: Loan guarantees and equity via intermediaries (no direct EU application)
grants.eligibility: EU-based companies; you apply to a local participating bank or fund, not to the EU
grants.notes: You never apply to the EU directly — find the accredited intermediary in your country.

grants.title: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Postdoctoral Researchers
grants.description: Brings highly qualified international postdocs to Germany for long-term research stays, with lifelong alumni support.
grants.amount: €2,800/month + family, travel, German course and equipment allowances
grants.eligibility: PhD within 4 years; any nationality except German; German host required
